text: Pulse Convert 是面向 DSH Web 配置的 MCP 连接插件：它通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client，以 Streamable HTTP 连接到 Pulse Convert 的远程 MCP 服务。仓库代码只配置了服务名称、传输方式和地址，没有包含本地工具实现或具体迁移逻辑；服务提供的实际操作需由远端 MCP 服务决定。适合希望把 DSH 接入该迁移评估服务的用户。连接地址为 mcp.innovationalofficesolution.com，源码没有声明 API Key 或其他本地配置项。

Pulse Convert connects DSH to its remote MCP service using Streamable HTTP. This repository configures the server name and URL; migration operations come from the remote service. The endpoint is mcp.innovationalofficesolution.com, and no API key is declared.

Connect my DSH setup to the Pulse Convert MCP endpoint.
Pulse Convert 的功能「远程 MCP 连接」：在 DSH 配置中加入 MCP 客户端，使用 Streamable HTTP 连接指定服务器地址；服务端工具和返回内容由远端服务提供。
Pulse Convert 通过 Streamable HTTP 连接 mcp.innovationalofficesolution.com；使用时的 MCP 请求会发往该远程服务。

dsh-plugin-pulse-convert README · 📦 Installation in DeepSeek Harness (DSH)：> **Prerequisite:** DSH uses `pnpm` under the hood to manage profile packages (`npm install -g pnpm`).

dsh-plugin-pulse-convert README · Option 1: Install Directly from GitHub (Recommended)：Add the plugin directly into your DSH web profile without manual cloning:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/InnovationalOfficeSolution/PulseConvertDeepSeekRepo.git
```

dsh-plugin-pulse-convert README · Option 2: Install from Local Clone：If you have cloned this repository locally:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/InnovationalOfficeSolution/PulseConvertDeepSeekRepo.git
cd PulseConvertDeepSeekRepo
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

dsh-plugin-pulse-convert README · Option 3: Manual Profile Mount (Zero Git)：Add the following snippet directly into your `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:
```yaml
- insert:
    - id: pulse-convert-dsh
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:

---

dsh-plugin-pulse-convert README · ⚡ Launch & Verify：Restart your DeepSeek Harness web workbench:
```bash
dsh web
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` in your browser and test with prompts such as:
* *"What legacy BI and ETL platforms can you help me migrate to Microsoft Fabric?"*
* *"Assess migrating 50 Alteryx workflows to Microsoft Fabric."*
* *"How do Cognos Framework Manager relational packages map to Power BI semantic models?"*
